T: Bread, circuses and a proper Roman feast.
D: Years after Maximus, Lucius is captured in North Africa and forced to fight in the Colosseum.
P: Serve the mains when the emperors throw their banquet.
S: Medjool dates and toasted almonds with a drizzle of honey and a pinch of sea salt.
Marinated olives, aged sheep's cheese and fresh figs laid out with crusty bread and a dish of olive oil.
Simple flatbreads brushed with olive oil, rosemary and salt, cooked in a hot pan until blistered.
M: Whole chicken roasted with honey, garlic, thyme and lemon until sticky and golden, with roast vegetables.
North African lamb and chickpea stew
Lamb shoulder stewed slowly with chickpeas, tomato, cumin, cinnamon and dried apricots, served over fluffy couscous.
W: Ricotta mixed with honey, egg and lemon zest, baked until set and drizzled with more honey.
K: the wine at the banquet, alcohol-free
Red grape juice warmed with cinnamon, cloves and orange peel, served warm or chilled.

s.how: Toast 150g almonds in a dry pan for 4 minutes. Pile on a plate with 16 medjool dates, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and finish with a pinch of sea salt flakes.
Lay out 200g mixed olives, 200g pecorino cut into shards and 6 halved figs on a board. Slice 1 crusty loaf and pour 4 tbsp olive oil into a dish for dipping.

m.how: Rub a 1.8kg whole chicken with oil, salt, crushed garlic and thyme and stuff with a halved lemon. Roast at 200C on a bed of 6 carrots for 60 minutes, then brush with 3 tbsp honey and roast 15 minutes more until sticky. Rest 10 minutes and carve.

w.how: Beat 500g ricotta with 3 eggs, 4 tbsp honey and the zest of 1 lemon until smooth. Pour into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170C for 40 minutes until just set. Cool and drizzle with 2 tbsp more honey.

d.note: the wine at the banquet, alcohol-free
d.how: Heat 1L red grape juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and 3 strips orange peel for 10 minutes without boiling. Serve warm in cups, or chill it and pour over ice.
